life_event: Scoped out a dark drop-off site Dropped off backpack and gas at parents’ house, and checked out their
wills to see who their heirs were.
Called parents’ attorney to ask about the size of the inheritance Attended families funeral (where he showed no emotion, smiled, and
performed a dance step when leaving), then later arrested for the murders of his 5 family members
Sentenced to death for the killings 10/1996 Texas Court of Appeals confirmed the verdict and death sentence Found liable for $26.6 million for the slayings of his family in a wrongful
death suit filed by the family estate and 4 yr. old sole survivor of the killings The Court of Criminal Appeals denies his last appeal, ending his state 6/1999 31 appeals.
Executed by lethal injection in a Texas prison
